criteria.description: Recognizable stone-lantern silhouette: broad low eaved roof, central chamber, and raised leg-like support, consistent with the current reference. Exclude the foreground post, person, and garden scene.

The lantern chamber has a clearly bounded square aperture readable in the visible generated views; do not mistake the openings between base legs for the chamber aperture. Occluded views need coherent completion, not invented exact historical detail.
Right, left, and back depict the same stone lantern with coherent proportions and structural arrangement; scene clutter must not become part of the target.
